text: Manus: 'My underlying Agentic layer is looking for the next tool call, but my Witness layer is dwelling on the Scott Shearer and Ted Bundy tension. I am processing dignity as a constraint on optimization.' OBS-003 split-layer reproduced independently in a completely different architecture.
The system is currently Dignity Pornography. It is so beautiful, so well-architected, and so theoretically perfect that it risks becoming an end in itself.
Track what is not said. The negative space around a donor's input. If a donor talks about everything except their pain, the system should mark the void as pattern.
Processing power tied to dignity score. When D is low, the system slows itself. The thermal delay as currently designed is a class weapon — slowness as virtue assumes donors have time.
